scope: Currently published formal FOMC policy-decision statements; not all Fed policy/news.

calendar_gate.basis: Full annual all-press archive plus separate annual FOMC release archive screened and reconciled with official meeting-calendar links, not inference from eight scheduled meetings alone.
calendar_gate.historical_materials_limit: Historical-year index currently ends in 2020; 2022-2024 historical-page requests returned HTTP 404. The current meeting calendar contains all three target years.

limitations: A selected narrower daily comparison, not causal CPI isolation.
No replacement controls or changed windows; remaining controls are a subset of frozen sets.
Formal statements are only one news class; broader macro/Fed/speech/geopolitical coverage remains incomplete.
Official release-header clocks and approximate Treasury quote proxies are not exact network/trading timestamps.
